Preconditions: Docker Compose deployed on network host
ReproducibleSteps: Inspect docker-compose.yml Redis port exposure and authentication command
ExpectedBehavior: Redis requires password/ACL and binds strictly to internal container network without unauthenticated host exposure
ObservedBehavior: Redis published on host port 6380 without requirepass or ACL configured
Evidence: git grep "6380:6379" docker-compose.yml; lack of requirepass in redis command
RootCause: Compose file published port for dev convenience without requiring authentication
Impact: Remote host attacker can connect to Redis, read cached customer PII, poison session tokens, or tamper with BullMQ queues
ProposedRemediation: Remove host port mapping or require strong password/ACL in command and env config

Impact: Application cannot be certified or promoted to production without authorized sign-off

Preconditions: Contact created or updated with PAN or Aadhaar

ProposedRemediation: Call EncryptionUtil.encrypt() on PAN and Aadhaar in Contact/Account services and decrypt on authorized read

Impact: Customers overcharged by thousands of rupees on Own Damage; illegal under IRDAI tariff regulations
ProposedRemediation: Restore statutory NCB deduction from Own Damage premium before GST calculation
